capabilities.description: Administrator-entered contract configuration: delay-damages rate and cap, retention percentage and retention release terms, contractual completion date, currency AED. The platform holds no defaults or assumptions for these figures and works only from what the administrator enters.
requirements: all contract figures — delay-damages rate and cap, retention percentage, retention release terms — must be configurable settings the administrator enters, never assumed by the platform

capabilities.description: Raising, reviewing and issuing payment certificates for the single civil-works contract, with certificate numbers generated and kept inside the platform.
requirements: No external accounting integration is wanted — certificate numbers stay inside the platform

capabilities.description: Automatically calculates retention off each payment certificate using the configured retention percentage and applies the configured retention release terms.
requirements: retention auto-calculated off each payment certificate
retention percentage, retention release terms — must be configurable settings the administrator enters

capabilities.description: Detects when the contractual completion date is missed and automatically deducts delay damages at the configured rate, bounded by the configured cap.
requirements: delay damages automatically deducted once the contractual completion date is missed (bounded by the configured cap)
delay-damages rate and cap ... must be configurable settings the administrator enters

capabilities.description: Routes an issued payment certificate for sign-off to the client reviewer, with approval rules governing the review and approval path.
requirements: certificate sign-off routed to the client reviewer when a certificate is issued

capabilities.description: Role-based permissions for the five roles — contracts manager, quantity surveyor, site engineer, finance, client reviewer — restricting who may raise, review and approve certificates.
requirements: operated by a small team of 5 with role-based permissions: contracts manager, quantity surveyor, site engineer, finance, and client reviewer
Role-based access restricts who can raise, review and approve certificates

capabilities.description: Records who configured contract figures, raised, reviewed, issued and approved each certificate, and every automated retention and delay-damages deduction.
requirements: Role-based access restricts who can raise, review and approve certificates
